statuses.PASS: All required cases passed, no required skips, including real inbox receipt and login
statuses.FAIL: An assertion, build, type check or security invariant failed
statuses.BLOCKED: A required infrastructure/credential/authorized recipient is missing
statuses.PARTIAL: No failure or missing prerequisite, but required verification remains incomplete

negativeControl: Disposable real API subprocess deliberately mutates AuthService.login to accept consumed codes; the same normal single-use acceptance assertion must exit nonzero, with process evidence. Incorrect OTP alone is not a mutation control.
requiredFailureInjection: Real API killed during SMTP DATA pending; restart cannot activate pending challenge
Populated historical SQL schema migrated through real prisma migrate deploy twice; user/flow/knowledge owners retained
evidencePolicy: Scan sanitized logs and nested text/XML/JSON reports, not only JSON keys; no required skips or flaky retry acceptance. Hash tracked plus untracked source contents while excluding secrets/env/binaries/dependencies/artifacts.
